acceptance_gates.scope: Actual final-native weighted-row MAP, marginal covariance and selected dynamic/global-nuisance cross-covariance agree with independent QR/GTSAM on small problems. This does not establish nonlinear fit convergence.

Actual final-native exact/near-rank rejection, gauges, missing constraints, unused directions, units, row/block ordering and equivalent nuisance elimination. No accepted covariance for deficient or unresolved systems.

The pulse local objective/prior check passed on actual 7fa execution. Density full OU rows passed, but all six completed derivative scales failed the unchanged 1e-4 criterion and the next repeated endpoint terminated on nuisance nonconvergence. The objective gate is not accepted for release.

Current controller/native transactional and fresh-undamped acceptance safeguards, plus actual final-native fixed-point nuisance-marginalized covariance export. No engineering optimizer convergence is asserted or required by this gate.

Final-native force/tangent kernels and actual propagated synthetic derivatives, including velocity coupling, pulse jumps, density knots and a full-day cancellation regression. Reused full-day evidence is explicitly component-bound.

Quantification of combined omitted flight sensitivities on one 30-minute April 24 window with fresh thermal history with degree 120 gravity and actual atmospheric drag. Passed means quantified approximation, not complete flight Jacobian.

Actual native code/carrier predictions satisfy the 1%-of-noise refinement threshold on two one-hour synthetic fixtures, selected 24-hour eccentric density, and one 30-minute flight window, with exact source/replay applicability to the final candidate.

Current 70 protocol and 8 startup unit checks, blind retained/fresh input verification and phase-coordinate comparison, plus independently verified final-candidate D-backed namespace, resource and row-retention readiness. Final launch proofs are separate; no benchmark execution or fit convergence is inferred.

benchmark.status_scope: Facts at this pre-benchmark acceptance snapshot; downstream attempt records and the inclusive report determine later execution completion.

candidate.source_snapshot_scope: Existing source_snapshot algorithm; validation and docs are excluded. Native Fortran is additionally pinned by build manifest/supplemental runtime inventory.

evidence_identity_policy: Actual execution identities are preserved in every evidence item. Component/output applicability is separately labeled and is never a substitute for a successful underlying gate. Tests and fixed-point checks do not imply optimizer convergence.
freeze_requirements: Pin this sealed index and every bundled gate hash in the execution context without editing them.
Retain the closed failed objective gate, unchanged source/build and unchanged numerical criteria throughout the experimental benchmark.

After preparation, write a separate launch record pinning final config, frozen inputs, startup verification and reserved CPU/protected-process proof; never add those downstream hashes back to these gate bundles.
Use a new immutable run if a pinned gate, source, binary, input or configuration changes.
freeze_scope: The acceptance evidence and gate statuses are sealed. This does not assert that downstream configuration, input-manifest, startup or CPU launch verification has completed.
scope: Immutable pre-benchmark acceptance snapshot: seven bounded gates passed and the objective/prior gate failed. The unchanged candidate is admitted only to the experimental 150-attempt benchmark with this nonpassing gate preserved. This is not an accepted numerical release and makes no reliability or accuracy-improvement claim.
